title: Howard Morland reconstructs the Teller-Ulam H-bomb design for The Progressive

tellings.quote: another guy named Howard Morland who heard that name >> who worked for the progressive magazine and he had the assignment see if you can figure out with no knowledge of physics the teller ulam design for the hydrogen bomb

plain: In 1979 a writer named Howard Morland, working for The Progressive magazine, was given the job of working out, with no training in physics, the Teller-Ulam design, the secret method behind the hydrogen bomb. The mathematician Eric Weinstein tells this to Michels without naming a source, setting it against the Atomic Energy Acts of 1946 and 1954, the US laws that made such nuclear knowledge secret. For Weinstein, it shows that a determined outsider can rebuild what the government keeps hidden.
